name: 10–20-Minute NSDR Session
title: Use a 10-to-20-minute NSDR session instead of pushing through.
benefit: Recovered energy and focus without more caffeine.
subtitle: Structured Rest
rationale: A guided deep-rest session restores more than pushing through a low-quality afternoon does.

evidence.summary: Guided deep-rest protocols descend from yoga nidra, where small studies report reduced stress and improved wellbeing; direct trials of NSDR itself are scarce.

sources.label: Meditation programs systematic review and meta-analysis

indications: Afternoon energy craters and caffeine is not an option.
Recovery time exists but sleep is not possible.
